_what: Every tracked file in the app brick template, with its measured size and what chassis step 4 does with it.
_why: ADR 065 set step 4 a target of ~205 lines. ADR 066 measured that as unsourced and unreachable and put the floor at ~2,900-3,550.
BOTH figures counted lib/ and the translations only. Measured 2026-09-05 the template is 18,205 lines across 96 files, and the
inherited test suite alone is 7,678 of them - 42% - which appears in no plan. That is three wrong numbers for one step, each
So the number stops living in prose. Every file gets a row; assert-chassis-ledger.mjs keeps the rows and the tree in bijection,
recomputes every count, and refuses a MOVE whose call site does not shrink. Nothing here is trusted - it is all re-measured.
MEASURED, not assumed: an undeclared file added to the brick reddened ZERO of the 127 assert-*.mjs guards on 2026-09-05
(17 were red both before and after, all of them needing build artifacts, credentials or CLI args). This ledger is the first
thing that makes the template a declared set.

verdicts.STAYS: This file is per-app by construction, or a guard requires it to remain here. It is not step 4 work.
verdicts.MOVES: Its content belongs in a shared package. REQUIRES a measured callSiteDelta, and that delta MUST be negative - ADR 066: a screen moves only when the calling code measurably shrinks.
verdicts.GOES: Deleted outright because nothing points at it any more. REQUIRES a measured callSiteDelta of 0 or less.
verdicts.UNCLASSIFIED: No verdict has been measured yet. This count is a ratchet: it may fall, never rise.

Its WATCHED_PAIRS entry in assert-no-seam-forks still existsSync on this path — an adapter is a file, not an absence.

[ADR 067] decision 2 / [ADR 071] — MEASURED 2026-09-06: 265 -> 75 brick lines, 292 package lines, callSiteDelta -190. What stayed is the ONE thing that could not travel: url_launcher and AppConfig.termsUrl/privacyUrl. Declaring url_launcher in packages/chassis_screens would make it an ADAPTER under assert-package-boundaries limb C (:185-201) and :288-298 would then fail the brick and every app for importing it directly, so the package takes onOpenTerms/onOpenPrivacy callbacks and the launcher call lives here under the dated brick|url_launcher bypass. This widget is still MOUNTED, not merely still present: sign_up and reaccept_terms hand their chassis views a ConsentFieldsBuilder that builds THIS class.

_classified: All 28 measured 2026-09-05 by deleting each file, running the full assert-*.mjs sweep, and diffing against a per-worktree baseline. NOT ONE of the 28 is deletable on its own: every source file is held by a named guard, and the three that only this ledger holds are tests kept on value. So chassis step 4 does not DELETE files. It shrinks the ones that stay, and delegates behaviour into packages where the call site measurably shrinks. AND THE HEADROOM IS SMALLER THAN IT LOOKS: 6,608 of these 15,560 lines (42%) are comment or blank. Stripping them from the six spine files alone removes 2,463 lines against a green sweep — but those comments are this corpus's recorded measurements and the reason several defects were ever found. Removing them would be measurable progress against a number and a real loss. Step 4 shrinks CODE.
